messages:
jordan: Heads-up — noticed permission drift after yesterday's SCIM group-sync (team-sync v2). A few deprovisioned IdP users still have access to `prod-db-read` and `redwood-admin`.
anya: Which groups/users? any logs/timestamps?
jordan: quick dry-run output below (ran `scim_sync --dry-run --since 2024-05-01T21:00Z`):
```
[INFO] start sync 2024-05-02T02:12:03Z
[group:eng-platform] expected_remove=12 actual_removed=0
[group:infra-admins] expected_remove=3 actual_removed=0
[WARN] found stale_members: user:uid-9832, user:uid-1102, user:uid-4475 still linked to redwood-admin
```
rafael: That looks like the mapping change we deployed in PR827 — we switched the SCIM->RBAC mapping to use `group.displayName` instead of `group.externalId` for matching. If externalId is primary in IdP, delta calculations might miss removals.
sara: Also check the IAM side: we refactored role `admin` -> `redwood-admin` last month. If group sync wrote to the old role key, deprovision might not have been propagated to the new role binding.
jordan: PR827 merged 2024-05-01T22:40Z — I reverted it locally and did the dry-run again. Now it reports the removals:
```
[INFO] running full-sync --force-full
[group:infra-admins] will_remove=3 -> user:uid-9832,user:uid-1102,user:uid-4475
[group:eng-platform] will_remove=12
```
kate: Before rolling anything back in prod we should run an audit for those user IDs (last 72h) to see if they accessed sensitive resources. I'll pull logs.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: release 2024.5.1 applied to scim-sync-service at 2024-05-01T22:35:12Z
rafael: Plan: revert mapping change in prod, then run `scim_sync --force-full --reason="fix-mapping-rollback"`, then POST `/admin/clear-perm-cache` for groups [infra-admins, eng-platform]. Also validate that SCIM service uses `externalId` for matching after rollback.
jordan: I've created a vuln-triage ticket and marked this as HIGH because of admin-role exposure. Will attach the audit once available.
anya: Security can own incident channel? I'll spin up #inc-1715001234 and add oncall.
sara: KMS note — I checked key access; the KMS IAM bindings didn't include those UIDs, so keys not directly affected. Recommend rotating any service keys if we see suspicious activity in the audit.
kate: Audit quick-check: no anomalous wide-scope API calls, but I found CLI access to DB snapshots from user:uid-1102  — adding to the ticket (evidence uploaded).
jordan: Action items: 1) rollback PR827 mapping (rafael) 2) run full SCIM sync + force cache clear (rafael) 3) deprovision the three IdP accounts (IdP-admin) 4) finish audit & update triage ticket (kate) 5) monitor for 24h and escalate if any odd activity. I'll handle comms to affected teams. :thumbsup:
rafael: Starting rollback now, notifying infra. ETA ~12m.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: rollback PR827 applied to scim-sync-service at 2024-05-02T02:18:05Z
jordan: Thanks — keep updates in #inc-1715001234.
